headline: Lashen Learning moves into ARC-2 gold as the cutoff shifts

sections.text: Lashen Learning rose from 18th to 16th, reaching 69.44 after a 2.91-point gain and taking the last of 16 provisional gold places.
ảc, which was 16th in the earlier report, now sits 17th at 69.17, 0.27 short of the line. ARC Raiders is 18th at 68.75 after dropping from 16th without a score change.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
